Label: Official Regulatory/Framework Document
Definition: Primary framework or statutory document issued by an authorised body (e.g., FHEQ, SLQF, Ofqual Regs).

Label: Quality Assurance or Oversight Guidance
Definition: Published code or handbook outlining QA, TNE, or validation oversight responsibilities.
Example Use: QAA Quality Code; OfS Conditions of Registration

Label: Recognition/Comparability Source
Definition: Official recognition or comparability statement relevant to UK–Sri Lanka alignment.
Example Use: UK ENIC/ECCTIS statement on GCE A/L equivalence

Label: National or Sector Policy
Definition: Government or funding-body document defining policy frameworks or qualification structures.
Example Use: DfE HE Reform 2023; SFC quality guidance

Label: Non-HE or Irrelevant Sector
Definition: Applies to schools, vocational training, or FE only, not higher education.

Label: Duplicate or Superseded Version
Definition: Older or identical version of a document already included.

Label: Commentary or Press Material
Definition: Opinion piece, blog, or news item not an official source.

Label: Non-UK/Sri Lankan Jurisdiction
Definition: Document issued by an authority outside target jurisdictions.

Label: Ambiguous or Mixed Relevance
Definition: Document partially meets inclusion criteria or references HE indirectly; requires discussion/second-reader decision.
Example Use: British Council Sri Lanka TNE brochure (general overview)
